chevron-mark-assemble-a.concept: Lone squares tumble across a field that keeps flipping between black and white until they find each other and lock into one solid chevron mark, so the brand reads as order made from scattered pieces. The copy is just the name: calm, confident and geometric.
chevron-mark-assemble-a.summary: Small squares fall and tumble on a field that snaps between white and black, lock into a geometric chevron mark with a red-orange keystone, then the field fades through grey to near black while each piece turns over to white and the mark glides up as an emblem over a white logo card and a bold sans company name.

beats.what: a single black square drops in from the top edge of a white field, motion blurred
it lands near the centre and keeps tumbling, rocking and turning a half turn as it floats
the field snaps from white to black and the square inverts to white in place
a second square drops in from the top and lands corner to corner on the first
the stacked pair rocks side to side as one piece
the pair twists apart and drifts upward, turning
both squares fall back toward the centre
the field snaps back to white, the squares invert to black and a chevron unfolds from a diamond at the bottom
the squares slam into the notch and lock with a small pulse
the top keystone diamond fills with the primary color
the field fades through grey to near black and each piece turns over edge on to white
the mark glides up and shrinks into an emblem
a white rounded logo card rises in under the emblem
the company name rises in below in white and the end frame holds
